convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Stochastic_Histogram custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Two signal modes with multi-buffer custom indicator reading make logic non-trivial.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: In Levels mode: buy close when Col[1]==2 (histogram in sell zone), sell close when Col[1]==0 (histogram in buy zone). In Cross mode: buy close when Up<Dn, sell close when Up>Dn.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus floating loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus floating loss

custom_logic_notes: Two TrendMode strategies in one EA: (1) Levels mode - uses buffer 4 (Col) which returns 0=buy zone, 2=sell zone; buy when Col[0]>0 and Col[1]==0, sell when Col[0]<2 and Col[1]==2. (2) Cross mode (default) - uses buffers 0 (Up) and 1 (Dn); buy on Up crossing above Dn, sell on Up crossing below Dn. Signal calculated on bar[SignalBar] with comparison to bar[SignalBar+1]. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs gate each signal type independently. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls bar-level signal evaluation. Recount flag forces signal recalculation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement Stochastic_Histogram custom indicator logic (5 buffers: Up, Dn, and color/zone buffer at index 4). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be rewritten in Python. The MarginMode enum provides 5 different position sizing methods that all need implementation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips) - need _Point/_Digits adjustment for target platform. Deviation=10 is slippage tolerance in points. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous closed bar (bar index 1), typical for avoiding repainting.
